reason: I take magnesium at night at home, I don't need it to go. A sachet a day is a nice idea, but I'm not paying about $30 a month for it when a bottle at the drugstore does the same job.
objection: I'm already covered at home and I don't trust supplements much unless my doctor says so. My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, not that I need this one, and a lab report on a page doesn't change that.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take this exact kind of magnesium, or my blood test coming back low and the price being close to what I pay now.
